ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is on the line segment $AB$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of the line segment $BC$. Given that $AB=10$ and $AC=6$, what is the length of the line segment $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution.} Since point D is the midpoint of line segment $BC$, and $AB=10$, $AC=6$,
\[\therefore BD = \frac{1}{2}BC =\frac{1}{2}\left(AB-AC\right) =\frac{1}{2}\left(10-6\right)=\boxed{2}.\]
